tokenizer.title_year: trailing (YYYY) removed from title and parsed

tokens.tb:: title bigram of consecutive non-stopword words

new_item_contract: tokenize title+genres with content_tokens, drop tokens absent from the vocabulary, weight by block_weight*idf, L2-normalise. Items need no interaction history.
user_profile: L2-normalised sum of positive-history item vectors; score = cosine with every item vector
